title: Spiced Pumpkin Gelato
changes_from_base: Pumpkin purée, brown sugar, honey and warm spices replace the pistachio milk; no egg yolks, the base is set with cornflour.
summary: Pumpkin pie in gelato form: smooth pumpkin purée, brown sugar, honey and warm spices in an egg-free milk base.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Slurry
steps.text: Whisk the cornflour with 60 ml of the milk until smooth.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Bring the rest of the milk, the cream, brown sugar, honey and salt to a simmer, whisk in the slurry and cook for 3 min, stirring, until it lightly coats the spatula.

steps.title: Spice
steps.text: Take off the heat and whisk in the pumpkin, spices and vanilla. For the smoothest texture, blend for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Sieve into the bowl over iced water, stir until cool, then cover and chill for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Pack into the container, cover the surface and freeze for at least 3 h. Leave in the fridge for 15 min before serving.

tips: Use plain pumpkin purée, not ready-spiced pie filling.
Grate the nutmeg fresh; it is much more fragrant than ready-ground.
Serve with crushed ginger biscuits or a spoon of caramel sauce.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep covered with baking paper pressed on the surface in the freezer for up to 2 weeks. Soften for 10-15 min in the fridge before scooping.
